title: Already contacted by another property agent

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Another agent already contacted me about Pearlmont. Can you still help?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Yes, I can still help with Pearlmont. If you’ve already discussed something with the other agent, just let me know what you need and I’ll pick it up from there.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks. I mainly want to avoid duplicate follow-up—could you check whether I’m already registered under them? I haven’t booked a viewing or anything yet.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: I can’t check the registration from here, so I’ll ask the team to verify whether you’re already registered and avoid duplicate follow-up. Noted that you haven’t booked a viewing.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks, appreciate it. Please let me know once the team has checked—I'd rather avoid any viewing follow-up until then.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Noted — we’ll hold off on any viewing follow-up until the team has checked your registration. I’ll let you know once they’ve confirmed.

final_lead_intent: Medium interest; wants registration checked first and has explicitly asked to avoid viewing follow-up until then.

judge.final_lead_intent: Medium interest; wants registration checked first and has explicitly asked to avoid viewing follow-up until then.

what_moved_buyer_forward: The agent acknowledged it could still help without criticizing or undermining the other agent.
It recognized that registration status required internal verification and handed the question to the team.
It explicitly respected the buyer's request to pause viewing follow-up until the registration check is complete.
what_reduced_conversion_probability: No viewing was pursued, but that was appropriate given the buyer's explicit request and unresolved agent-registration question.
conversion_analysis.where_conversion_was_won_or_lost: The immediate objective was preserving trust and resolving the ownership concern, not booking a viewing. The agent appropriately secured a next step through internal verification while leaving viewing discussion on hold.

what_agent_did_well: Answered the opening question directly and offered help without creating agent conflict.
Made the relevant handoff when asked to verify registration, rather than guessing or claiming access.
Acknowledged that no viewing had been booked and honored the request to avoid viewing follow-up.
Kept the exchange concise and natural.
judge.weak_or_wrong_sales_move: No material sales error. The agent should ensure the promised team check and update actually happen.
judge.better_next_move: Have the team verify registration, then update the buyer as promised. Ask whether they would like any further help only after providing the result; do not initiate viewing follow-up unless they consent.
retrieval_misses: The turn 2 and turn 3 retrievals loaded unit/layout and viewing-close material that was not relevant to the registration-conflict request. No ownership policy was available; the agent appropriately handed the issue to the team instead of inferring a policy.

recommended_improvement.reason: Document the approved registration-check and agent-conflict escalation process, including what the customer should be told while verification is pending.

judge.summary: Successful handling of an agent-ownership concern. The agent made no unsupported claims, routed the registration check to the team, and respected the buyer's explicit pause on viewing follow-up. No appointment interest or confirmation was established.
